attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 36 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, 36 persistent and 1 shell, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 94 to 99.8% of genes there, fewest at column 8, `yaeF`, 94%, and hesitates most at column 16, `ldcC`, 0.44 bits. The `metN`, `metQ`, `lpxA` and `ispC` genes sit here.

**A single variable column follows.** Column 37, `yaeI`, is variable, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls, named in 84% and 0.60 bits. Then columns 38 to 52 are spine again, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 3% of calls, named in 88 to 98%, fewest at column 52, `fhuC`, 88%. The `fhuD` and `fhuC` genes lie here, and column 48, `yadX`, is the most hesitant at 0.31 bits.

**The graph opens at the fimbrial stretch.** Columns 62 to 68 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 37 to 85% of calls, named in 27 to 79%, fewest at column 65, 27%, and most hesitant at column 64, `htrE`, 1.03 bits. The forks carry `yadN`, `yadV`, `yadK` and an IS1-like element transposase; the variable columns carry `htrE`, `yadM`, `yadL` and `yadC`, [[fimbrial adhesin and pilus genes]].

**The window closes on persistent columns.** Columns 69 to 78 are spine, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 7% of calls, named in 89 to 97%, fewest at column 69, `panB`, 89%. The `panB` and `panC` genes lie here. The last column, 79, is a fork: `gcd` in 85% of chromosomes, with `cueO` and `yacC`, named in 95% and 0.22 bits.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.97 against 0.12 bits, and names fewer genes, 40% against 98%; 3,888 of the 41,680 calls are inside a region of plasticity. Across the window it names 93% of genes at 0.20 bits on average.

label: dkgB
facts:
WINDOW: the dkgB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor dkgB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,512 to 3,591 from dnaA. Read in 521 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying dkgB once); 41,680 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,217 calls, named 99%, 0.10 bits; shell 5,232 calls, named 53%, 0.80 bits; cloud 231 calls, named 0%, 2.21 bits. Outside an RGP 37,792 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; inside an RGP 3,888 calls, named 40%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 70 spine, 4 fork, 6 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.12 bits) and names fewer genes (40% against 98%); 3,888 of the 41,680 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 64 (htrE) 1.03 bits, RGP 85%; column 62 (yadN) 0.92 bits, RGP 84%; column 63 (yadV) 0.86 bits, RGP 85%. The 6 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 48%, 0.70 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 96%, 0.16 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 62-68 (fork and variable columns), RGP 37-85%; the least: column 37 (variable), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-36 (37 columns) spine: share 91-100%, 36 P, 1 S, RGP 0-3%. Genes: dkgB, gmhB, metN, metI "methionine ABC transporter permease…", metQ, rcsF, tsaA, proS, yaeF "YaeF family permuted papain-like en…", nlpE, arfB, yaeQ "YaeQ family protein", yaeP "YaeP family protein", rof, tilS, yaeR "VOC family protein", ldcC, accA, dnaE, rnhB, lpxB "lipid-A-disaccharide synthase", lpxA, fabZ, lpxD, skp, bamA, rseP, cdsA, ispU "(2E,6E)-farnesyl-diphosphate-specif…", ispC, frr, pyrH, tsf, rpsB, map, glnD, dapD. named 94-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 8 (yaeF), named 94%; most hesitant at column 16 (ldcC), 0.44 bits.
2. column 37 variable: RGP 2%. named 84%; 0.60 bits.
   37: yaeI S 55% "phosphodiesterase YaeI"
3. columns 38-52 (15 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: yaeH "DUF3461 family protein", cdaR, degP, dgt, mtnN, btuF, yadS "TRIC cation channel family protein", erpA, yadW "small protein YadW", clcA, yadX, hemL, fhuB "iron chelate uptake ABC transporter…", fhuD, fhuC. named 88-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 52 (fhuC), named 88%; most hesitant at column 48 (yadX), 0.31 bits.
4. column 53 variable: RGP 4%. named 91%; 0.38 bits.
   53: fhuA S 79%
5. columns 54-61 (8 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 4-45%. Genes: mrcB, hrpB, thpR, sfsA, dksA, gluQRS, pcnB, folK. named 74-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61 (folK), named 74%, 0.48 bits.
6. columns 62-68 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 37-85%. named 27-79% (mean 52%), fewest named at column 65, named 27%; most hesitant at column 64, 1.03 bits.
   62 fork: yadN S 57% "fimbrial protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 24%, yadV S 14%
   63 fork: yadV S 56%; also htrE S 13%
   64 variable: htrE S 48%
   65 variable: yadM S 35% "fimbrial protein"
   66 variable: yadL S 35% "fimbrial-like protein YadL"
   67 fork: yadK S 48% "fimbrial-like protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 11%
   68 variable: yadC S 27% "fimbrial-like adhesin"
7. columns 69-78 (10 columns) spine: share 93-96%, all P, RGP 3-7%. Genes: panB, panC "pantoate--beta-alanine ligase", rpnC, panD, yadE, yadI "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", yadH "ABC transporter permease", yadG "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", can, hpt. named 89-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 69 (panB), named 89%; most hesitant at column 70 (panC), 0.45 bits.
8. column 79 fork: RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.22 bits.
   79: gcd P 85%; also cueO P 56%, yacC P 27%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): metN methionine ABC transporter ATP-binding…; metQ methionine ABC transporter substrate-bi…; lpxA acyl-ACP--UDP-N-acetylglucosamine O-acy…; ispC 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate reductoi…; fhuD ABC transporter substrate-binding prote…; fhuC ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; fhuA ferrichrome porin FhuA; panB 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltr…; yadN fimbrial protein; yadV fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone; htrE FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-containing…; speE polyamine aminopropyltransferase; cueO multicopper oxidase CueO; yacC YacC family pilotin-like protein
END: the window ends at column 79, gcd, in 85% of chromosomes.
